page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.3xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 6 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.9 GHz, with 2 threads per core. The memory configuration provides 24.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The CPU includes a 48 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including AVX512F and AVX512_VNNI) and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps under the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations place the ecs.c7se.3xlarge in the average performance tier across most metrics. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is recorded at 1870.18, while multi-core performance reaches 11653.27. Memory bandwidth tests show a cached read speed of 638.72 GB/sec, which drops to 82.59 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 52.05 GB/sec. In application-specific workloads, the instance achieves a Geekbench multi-core score of 7822.0 and a software compilation score of 11904.0. Database performance is highlighted by a Passmark database operations score of 6078.68 and a Redis SET throughput of 11.96 million operations per second. For lightweight machine learning, prompt processing with a small 135M LLM model reaches 1066.75 tokens per second, though scaling to a medium 7B model drops prompt processing speed to a weak 24.22 tokens per second.

From a resource allocation perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-heavy tasks that do not require massive memory footprints. However, the lack of local storage means all storage operations must rely on network-attached volumes, which may introduce latency tradeoffs. The absence of a GPU also limits its utility for heavy deep learning tasks. Given these characteristics, the ecs.c7se.3xlarge is well-suited for workloads such as software compilation, web serving, medium-scale database operations, and lightweight text or image processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.3xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance powered by a 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It delivers 12 dedicated vCPUs (6 physical cores) and 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The hardware supports AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration but lacks local storage and dedicated GPUs, relying instead on a 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark results indicate average performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 7822.0, a Passmark database score of 6078.68, and a Redis throughput of 11.96 million SET operations per second. While highly capable for compute-bound tasks, its 2.0 GB of memory per core presents a tradeoff for memory-intensive applications. This instance is best suited for web serving, software compilation, and moderate database workloads.
